data.long_meaning: Fredrick is an English name derived from Old English frēod and ric, meaning 'peaceful ruler'. In Old English literature, Fredrick was used as a name for both men and women. In the Christian tradition, it is associated with the virtue of peace. The name Fredrick carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fredrick usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
